text: Quick one. Daughter's 4 and she's got a few insect bites on her legs that she keeps scratching at. Anything I can put on them tonight or do I wait till the pharmacy opens? She's not ill otherwise. She's flopped on the sofa because we've been out all day, but she's chatting away and watching telly, and she's her normal colour, lips and all. Just need to know what to do about the itching.
